recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. If terminology owners want the external THO CodeSystem metadata aligned, handle that separately through terminology/UTG; the core build no longer describes the value set or binding as generic handling instructions.
issue_request: FHIR-14752 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for a STU3 SpecimenDefinition ballot comment that the handling-condition value set contained temperature concepts but the element/value set text described a general set of handling instructions. The accepted resolution renamed conditionSet to temperatureQualifier, renamed tempRange to temperatureRange, and directed non-temperature handling conditions to the instruction element.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found. The 2018 SpecimenDefinition tracker-items commit fe1633005f changed the old spreadsheet element paths from conditionSet/tempRange to temperatureQualifier/temperatureRange, and the current XML source preserved those names and temperature-specific element definitions. The active binding and ValueSet descriptions still retained the old generic handling-instruction wording.
additional_context: SpecimenDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and both edited XML files are part of the current core build source. OO Confluence minutes record FHIR-14752 as approved and applied. Focused Jira/Zulip searches found no conflicting later issue or discussion. The external THO CodeSystem for handling-condition still has similar legacy metadata, but this reconciliation only changes the in-scope FHIR core source.
reconciliation: Updated source/specimendefinition/structuredefinition-SpecimenDefinition.xml and source/specimendefinition/valueset-handling-condition.xml to describe the binding and ValueSet as qualifiers for the temperature interval of specimen handling before testing, without changing the canonical URL, binding name, code system, or example binding strength.
